notes: Straightforward narrative verse; all 21 morphemes and all 25 target tokens are accounted for, each morpheme holding an English word.
`תַּחַת` takes *in ... stead* as one discontinuous unit around the possessive (rule 25), headed on *stead* as the word carrying the lexeme (rule 24); the suffix keeps its own *his*.
`עִיר דָּוִיד` writes no article morpheme, so the construct takes a supplied *the* and the rectum the *of* (rules 19, 29).
